supersedes.reason: carries the accepted seven-source operation plans and HQ200's corrected authority/policy distinctions

critical_statements: THIS DOCUMENT IS AN UNSIGNED SUCCESSOR. IT IS NOT A WARRANT. IT AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
R9 IS NOT CLOSED. This lane closes no technical account.
No numeric real-source byte ceiling is asserted.
Candidate policy ceilings occupy MAXIMUM fields only and are never frozen historical authority.
PRQ-07 is DISCHARGED and is not carried as an open blocker.
Zero source access, locator discovery, warrant issuance, live C4, production mutation, C7 or actor/person work was performed.

two_stage_law.stage_2_during_run_MEASURED: exact observed count, retained on return

mandatory_separate_accounts: file hash passes (full SHA-256 over the file)
settled_o1_c07_structure.non_substitutability: Literal path opens, reader invocations and decoder invocations are separately named, non-substitutable quantities.
settled_o1_c07_structure.outer_route_pass_law: The outer governed full Route-B pass is a WORKLOAD account, separate from every lower-layer access account, and is never summed into or substituted for any of them.

four_field_law.observed_null_law: null with a typed reason; never a fabricated zero or PASS

authority_status_vocabulary.FROZEN_AUTHORITY: supplied by a governing artifact, with exact provenance
authority_status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTATION_POLICY: a binding ceiling adopted as execution policy; NOT a historical expected value
authority_status_vocabulary.PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE: a named account for which no governing value exists
authority_status_vocabulary.UNBOUND_SOURCE_DEPENDENT: cannot be fixed source-free because it depends on the real source
authority_status_vocabulary.PENDING_HQ200_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE: candidate maximum whose runtime/session mechanism is not yet accepted

byte_account_law.rule: No lawful derivation rule exists in frozen authority, so the requirement is preserved as issuance-blocking.

typed_null_law.rationale: A null or absent pre-launch budget would silently waive a launch prerequisite.
